title: Evolution Dataset Manifest
description: Declares which dataset_blocks feed a single evolution run, which models are targeted, and what the training recipe looks like. One manifest = one coherent fine-tuning campaign. Produced by the evolution pipeline (gad evolution evolve) before training begins. Glues dataset_block + retain_bank + preference_pair + agent_trace into a single auditable unit.

evolution_id.description: ID of the gad evolution evolve session that produced this manifest. Links to .planning/phases/<phase>/evolution/ artifacts.

projectid.description: gad project scope. 'slm-learning' for training campaigns; 'global' when monorepo traces are the primary source.

dataset_blocks.description: All dataset_block entries participating in this evolution, with their role in the recipe.

role.description: 'train' = SFT source; 'eval' = held-out evaluation; 'retain' = retain_bank replayed against; 'preference' = DPO pairs.

target_models.description: Models this evolution campaign produces or fine-tunes.

model_id.description: Internal alias for the output model. Example: 'kael-1p5b-v2'.

lane.description: Size lane. Determines which retain banks and eval suites apply.

training_recipe.description: Ordered pointers to which dataset_blocks fill each training slot.

sft_blocks.description: dataset_ids used in supervised fine-tuning phase.

dpo_blocks.description: dataset_ids used in DPO preference-tuning phase.

retain_blocks.description: retain_bank IDs replayed to prevent catastrophic forgetting.

eval_gates.description: Eval IDs that must all pass before the evolution is promoted.

expected_promotion_criteria.description: Human-readable statement of what 'done' looks like for this evolution. Example: 'kael-1p5b-v2 scores >= 0.72 on kael-sft-eval-v1 AND all retain bank rows pass'.

notes.description: Free-form notes on this manifest: experiments tried, risks, operator instructions.

examples.expected_promotion_criteria: kael-1p5b-v1 scores >= 0.72 on kael-sft-eval-v1 AND all retain bank rows pass
examples.notes: First evolution. SFT data is sparse; treat as pilot. Expand kael-sft-v1 to 200+ rows before next evolution.
